components.css: .ds-card{max-width:300px;padding:14px 12px 0;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card-bg);color:var(--foreground);font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),Arial,sans-serif}.ds-card button{padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font-family:inherit;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.035em;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-card button:hover{color:var(--accent)}.ds-card button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px}.ds-card p{margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px}.ds-card dl{display:flex;gap:11px;margin:17px 0 15px;color:var(--spec-text);font-size:8px}.ds-card dt{font-family:var(--font-geist-mono),monospace;font-size:7px}.ds-card dd{margin:4px 0 0}.ds-card footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:13px 0}.ds-card strong{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:600}.ds-card footer span{font-size:8px;color:var(--muted)}

narrative.overview:
FORME treats the workspace as a property register: off-white paper, carbon typography, visible rules, and a single red accent. Heavy display type establishes hierarchy; compact monospaced labels identify records, actions, and measurements. Architectural photographs add context within the grid.

The interface is flat, square, and deliberately dense on desktop. Manage and Explore share the same visual language; the workspace switch changes tasks without changing identity.
keyCharacteristics: Heavy, tightly spaced headings paired with monospaced metadata.
Hairline compartments, square controls, and restrained tonal surfaces.
Red for primary actions, selected navigation, and attention.
Muted architectural photography with readable property information below.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use red to signal action or state; retain neutral surfaces for the surrounding information.

dos: Do use the existing CSS primitives and shared property card and dialog components.
Do keep heavy headings, compact mono labels, and visible rules in distinct roles.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and explicit status text.
Do keep photographs contextual and record their source.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, ambient shadows, or additional accent colors.
Don't lighten the red without checking its text and button contrast pairings.
Don't turn short metadata styling into the default for long-form text.
Don't require the overview's three-column portfolio and rail on unrelated screens.
